steps: Both of you complete the county's marriage license application online, then book an in-person appointment (appointments open up to 3 weeks ahead).
Both of you go to the appointment together with valid photo ID and pay the license fee: $91 for a public license, $85 for a confidential license.

If you want the county to marry you, book a prepaid 15-minute civil ceremony ($35); the county only gives the ceremony appointment once you hold your license. A county-provided witness is $20, and a confidential license needs no witness.
Marry within 90 days of getting the license.
Return the signed license to the Norwalk office so it can be recorded.
left_out: Waiting period: no lavote.gov page (and the California state license page) says in words that there is no waiting period, so it is not quoted.
Fee for a certified copy of the marriage certificate: not on the lavote.gov marriage pages read (the Recorder's records pages were not read).

notes: READ THIS. (1) Hidden county fee notice: the HTML source of lavote.gov's About page (marriage-licenses-ceremonies/general-info/about) holds a COMMENTED-OUT notice, not shown to visitors, saying the Board of Supervisors approved new fees (public license $176, confidential $220, ceremony $44, witness $26) effective 30 days after an ordinance is adopted. It is not a published fact today, so it is not in the facts. The Fees page still shows $91 / $85 / $35 / $20; re-check lavote.gov/.../fees/fees right before publishing. (2) Quote check: tools/verify_quotes.py strips tags but NOT HTML comments, so it would also pass hidden text. I also checked every quote against the visible text of the downloaded pages (comments, script and style removed). Example of why: the eligibility page's list of acceptable ID has 'Alien resident card' inside a comment; the visible list is Driver's license and Passport only, and the id_needed quote uses only the visible words. (3) Waiting period: no lavote.gov page states it, so it is left out; the California Department of Public Health general-information page was read too and does not say it either (it does say licenses are valid 90 days). (4) Web search budget ran out mid-task, so the venue list was built from the venues' own sites reached through directory pages (leads only) and direct fetches; it is NOT exhaustive and several famous venues print no price (Descanso, Arboretum, Annenberg Beach House [only a $450 ceremony fee on top of rental], Hollywood Forever, Ebell, hotels). (5) Weak entries, flagged for the coordinator: Get Married Today is an office-based same-day marriage service (its balcony row has a guest count but the page says only 'select locations' / 'participating chapels'; its plain chapel row, License + Ceremony with Guests (Casual) $485, prints no guest limit); Cecile Trattoria is a per-guest price (price_unit 'per guest') and is listed last, not in amount order; Heritage Square is 'starting at'; La Venta Inn and Greystone are not small-group packages but ceremony-only/weekday rates with caps of 100 and 75 guests; Orcutt Ranch is a City of Los Angeles Recreation and Parks weekday (Mon-Thu) 3-hour rental with a 175-person capacity, and the page says prices are subject to change without notice. Los Angeles Wedding Chapel (laweddingchapel.com, Boyle Heights; Religious Wedding Package from $498.00, Civil from $398.00) was dropped because its price page prints no guest count. (6) Tiers: Albertson (0-5 guests $320; 6-18 $390; 19-29 $520; 30-42 $720, Monday to Friday and Sunday, closed Tuesdays), Lucky Wedding Day (Happy Package, couple only, $399.99; Sweet 1-10 $449.99; Lovely 11-20 $549.99; Luxury 21-30 $649.99) and Cute Little Wedding Chapel (0-4 guests $450, 5-15 $550, 16-30 $650, +$50 Saturday and Sunday) all price by guest count; the entry uses the lowest tier with guests and the other tiers are in price_for. Albertson's separate packages page says its package prices expire 10/31/2026 (three days after the read date); the ceremony-only page used for the quote has no expiry line. Cute Little Wedding Chapel and Lucky Wedding Day prices include a marriage license (the page says so); Albertson's ceremony-only price does not (license set is a paid add-on). (7) Greystone: the City of Beverly Hills page prints 'Approximate Rental Fees': $2,200 for Beverly Hills residents, $2,600 for non-residents (1 to 75 people, ceremony only); amount uses the non-resident rate. (8) Photographer: Golden Vibes Photo is 'based in Long Beach, California' per the meta description of goldenvibesphoto.com (not visible text, so not quoted); the quoted row is the 'courthouse weddings' tier. (9) Florist: Hanamate (Alhambra, CA per its Zola listing; its About page says 'Serving Southern California') sells bridal bouquets on its own Shopify store: Delicate Bouquets for Bride / Bridesmaids (Customize) $98.00 and Natural Elegance Bridal Bouquet (customize) $168.00. Not a courthouse-specific bouquet; delivery/pickup terms for Los Angeles were not stated on the pages read. (10) Cute Little Wedding Chapel also runs a $14 Valentine's Day ceremony special (one day a year); not used. (11) Ceremony facts for the county: the Ceremonies page says ceremonies are done at all RR/CC offices, while the Branch Office Locations page lists specific weekdays per office (e.g. Beverly Hills Wed/Fri, Van Nuys Wed/Fri, East LA Fri); book through the county's system and check the office/day.
